Name: Pacific Northwest Mushrooms
Author: pHScale
Description:
[b]Pacific Northwest Mushrooms

[/b]This mod adds a variety of mushrooms to the game, both forageable and cultivatable. These mushrooms are based on a variety of mushrooms found in the Pacific Northwest of the United States.

[b]Currently Available Mushrooms[/b]
[list]
[*]Apricot Jelly Ear*
[*]Bear's Tooth*
[*]Bolete
[*]Cauliflower Mushroom
[*]Chicken-of-the-Woods*
[*]Coral Mushroom
[*]Fly Agaric
[*]Jelly Ear*
[*]Lion's Mane*
[*]Lobster Mushroom
[*]Matsutake
[*]Oyster Mushroom*
[*]Polypore*
[*]Porcini
[*]Puffball
[*]Reishi*
[*]Slippery Jack
[*]Turkey Tail*
[*]Wild Truffle
[*]Witch's Butter*
[/list]
Mushrooms marked with an asterisk (*) are currently only available to cultivate. I'm waiting on the release of the BURT framework to implement these how I'd like to for foraging.

[b]Huge thanks to Floogen for their help with the mushroom artwork![/b]
